newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Heavy to stop making luxury coupes.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Heavy to stop making luxury coupes.

text.p: Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd said on Wednesday it would stop production of its Alcyone SVX luxury two-door specialty coupe at the end of December.
Fuji Heavy, the maker of Subaru brand cars, decided to stop making the Alcyone SVX due to poor demand worldwide for luxury two-door coupe models, a Fuji Heavy spokesman said.
Alcyone SVX, powered by 3.3-litre flat-6 engine, was designed by Italian car designer Georgetto Giugiaro.
Fuji Heavy, owned 4.2 percent by Nissan Motor Co Ltd, had produced a total of 24,236 Alcyone SVXs as of end-October after launching it in September 1991.

The model has been marketed mainly in the United States. Fuji Heavy has sold a total of 5,800 Alcyone SVXs in Japan in the five years since the launch. Its price in Japan ranged between 3.16 and 3.26 million yen.
